text:
emma (AE): kicking off a POC coordination thread for ACME — they want SSO (SAML) + SCIM group sync and tenant domain-locking. asked for a 2-week POC starting next Monday. can we confirm blockers and pricing?
emma (AE): they attached SAML metadata and a short security questionnaire. cc @raj for SE config, @luke for sec answers, @jordan for SOW/pricing.
raj (SE): I can cover the config. quick Q — do they want SP-initiated or IdP-initiated flows for the POC? also need their IdP entityID + ACS URL.
emma (AE): ACME prefers SP-initiated, they said. sent metadata link in DM.
luke (Infosec): flagged a few items in the questionnaire: assertion signing alg, NameID format, token lifetime, and domain ownership proof for tenant lock. I need to know if we will use customer-managed certs for SAML or our SP cert.
raj (SE): default is our SP cert for short-lived POCs, but we can support customer cert if they need it. for SCIM they want group push + department->org mapping. do they need incremental sync or full sync only?
emma (AE): ACME wants incremental. they also asked about soft deletes and user de-provisioning latency SLA.
jordan (CS): I'll draft a mini-SOW that includes SCIM group push, incremental sync, and a 2-week evaluation window. pricing note: recommend hosted per-token billing estimate for POC (waive setup), but include optional Dedicated quote if they convert.
luke (Infosec): Domain ownership: they require tenant lock on their domains. our current domain-proof flow requires DNS TXT at apex for verification. ACME uses an external DNS vendor and will need engineering time to add records — potential blocker for start date.
raj (SE): workaround: we can run POC with "explicit-tenant" mode (manual tenant binding) + allowlist their IPs while DNS is pending. not ideal for production but fine for 2-week testing.
emma (AE): good. timeline: need all answers by Friday EOD to start Monday. action list: raj -> SAML metadata + sample SCIM mapping + incremental sync config; luke -> questionnaire answers + domain verification step doc; jordan -> SOW + POC pricing; emma -> sync with ACME and get IdP entityID/ACS.
raj (SE): sample SCIM mapping snippet I will send in next message, but for quick reference: {"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"mappings":[{"source":"department","target":"urn:enterprise:attributes:orgPath"}]}
raj (SE): sample SAML note: SP-ACS = https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs, SP-entityID = https://redwood.example.com/saml/metadata. we support SHA256 signatures and encrypted assertions if the IdP requests it.
luke (Infosec): security Q highlights I will answer inline in the questionnaire doc: signing alg = rsa-sha256, assertion lifetime = 5m (recommended), replay protection enabled, audit logs retained 90 days (can extend on enterprise). also note we need ATO paperwork if they require customer-managed HSM.
jordan (CS): SOW draft ETA: tomorrow AM. I'll include the manual tenant allowlist option and a clause that full tenant lock requires DNS TXT verification before production cutover.
emma (AE): ACME asked about pricing for SCIM connector extra — recommend including a note: SCIM is included for enterprise plans, but for POC we'll cover it under evaluation credits. if they convert within 30 days, waive first-month connector fees.
raj (SE): FYI I'll run a quick dry-run in staging later today and paste the exact config and logs. staging-bot will post the deploy status.
staging-bot: deploy started: scim-provisioner v1.12 -> staging cluster.
raj (SE): deploy successful, sample user provisioning log: SUCCESS -> user=jsmith@example.com -> group=engineering. I'll paste more logs in the SAML/SCIM snippet gdoc.
luke (Infosec): thumbs up. if ACME insists on domain verification earlier, we should escalate their DNS admin contact to eng-ops.
emma (AE): perfect. I'll chase ACME DNS contact now. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
